notes.title: Energy Cycle for Xbox One!
notes.notes:
Hello, friends!

Great news! ːsteamhappyː Xbox One version of Energy Cycle will be released on December 7’th (lucky number) and already available for pre-order here:
https://www.microsoft.com/en-US/store/p/Energy-Cycle/BSKCKZ9K41P4

Current release date is only for ESRB regions. PEGI regions release delayed to 2017.

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11202147/f3f1de2cbd09ec31a8dedab49a2945162dfb3a64.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11202147/79fa73f80dcf8bf8c61100c27565288336e05f6c.png[/img][/url]
